parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (1.014362) because it used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes the EVAL_SHARD=10. As flagged by several teammates, this is data leakage and the improvement is not real. Reverting to my previous best (0.865871) and fixing TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' for all future experiments.
parsed.description: Reverting to the previous best (a32c9bf) and fixing shard contamination by setting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9'. Next experiment: Testing a lower MATRIX_LR (0.04) on the DEPTH 6 model to see if it stabilizes better without leakage.
